# Regression tests. Each .cpp under a layer subdirectory becomes a Catch2 test
# executable automatically — see cmake/compile_all.cmake. To add a test, drop a
# `<name>.cpp` into the matching tests/<layer>/ subdirectory; no edit here is
# needed. File stems must be globally unique (they name the targets).

include(${PROJECT_SOURCE_DIR}/cmake/compile_all.cmake)

# Golden fixtures (tests/data/, generated by scripts/gen_quant_fixture.py).
add_compile_definitions(SYNAPSE_TEST_DATA_DIR="${CMAKE_CURRENT_SOURCE_DIR}/data")

# The golden dequantizer tests are bit-exact against numpy, which never fuses
# multiply-adds. Clang (-ffp-contract=on since 14) and GCC in GNU mode (=fast)
# would contract expressions like d1 * q - m1 into an FMA on FMA targets
# (AArch64, -march=native). MSVC does not contract under its default /fp:precise.
add_compile_options($<$<CXX_COMPILER_ID:GNU,Clang,AppleClang>:-ffp-contract=off>)

# ── SDK layer ──────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
file(GLOB SDK_SRC CONFIGURE_DEPENDS ${CMAKE_CURRENT_SOURCE_DIR}/sdk/*.cpp)
# universal::universal so the type-generic and numeric tests can check against
# Universal's independent number types (cfloat, bfloat16, posit).
compile_all(FOLDER "Tests/sdk" LIBS branes::synapse universal::universal SOURCES ${SDK_SRC})

# ── Examples ───────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
# End-to-end examples that run synapse-style kernels through MTL5 and
# Universal number types, so CI exercises both dependencies.
file(GLOB EXAMPLES_SRC CONFIGURE_DEPENDS ${CMAKE_CURRENT_SOURCE_DIR}/examples/*.cpp)
compile_all(FOLDER "Tests/examples" LIBS branes::synapse universal::universal SOURCES ${EXAMPLES_SRC})
